visible_turns.text: Yes , I am kidding.But don't you know only professors and students with disabilitiescan apply for parking permits ?
Oh , I'm sorry . I didn't know .
Here is the application form . I also need to see your student ID and your permission letter from the university .
Yes , the letter that certifies you have a disability.And it must certify your disability entitles you to a parking place .
Yes . Or you can bring it yourself .
Let me look in the file then . Maybe we received it .
Yes , here it is.Alright . Then I just need your completed application form , and I will be able to process your request .
The form has a map on the back . You may specify your top four choices.We will give a spot in the lot that has an opening .
